methods.name: with_id
methods.summary: Sets optional field id and returns itself.

methods.name: with_length
methods.summary: Sets type length and returns itself. This is only applied to FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY and INT96 (INTERVAL) types, because they maintain fixed size underlying byte array. By default, value is `0`.

methods.name: with_logical_type
methods.summary: Sets [`LogicalType`] for this field and returns itself. If only the logical type is populated for a primitive type, the converted type will be automatically populated, and can thus be omitted.

methods.name: with_precision
methods.summary: Sets precision for Parquet DECIMAL physical type and returns itself. By default, it equals to `0` and used only for decimal context.

methods.name: with_repetition
methods.summary: Sets [`Repetition`] for this field and returns itself.

methods.name: with_scale
methods.summary: Sets scale for Parquet DECIMAL physical type and returns itself. By default, it equals to `0` and used only for decimal context.
